result.topic_en: Calculations in elasticity/kinematics: conditions for vanishing strain components (rigid-body displacement u, v, w), transformation of displacement derivatives under a rotation of axes in the x-y plane, and the stresses for a torsional displacement field with the resulting moment integral.

$\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}=\cos\varphi\frac{\partial u}{\partial x'}-\sin\varphi\frac{\partial u}{\partial y'}$ $\frac{\partial v}{\partial x}=\cos\varphi\frac{\partial v}{\partial x'}-\sin\varphi\frac{\partial v}{\partial y'}$
$\frac{\partial u}{\partial y}=+\sin\varphi\frac{\partial u}{\partial x'}+\cos\varphi\frac{\partial u}{\partial y'}$ $\frac{\partial v}{\partial y}=\sin\varphi\frac{\partial v}{\partial x'}+\cos\varphi\frac{\partial v}{\partial y'}$

$\frac{\partial v}{\partial x}+\frac{\partial u}{\partial y}=2\cos\varphi\sin\varphi\frac{\partial u'}{\partial x'}-2\cos\varphi\sin\varphi\frac{\partial v'}{\partial y'}+(\cos\varphi^2-\sin\varphi^2)\left(\frac{\partial v'}{\partial x'}+\frac{\partial u'}{\partial y'}\right)$
